(3) If in exercise of the power conferred by sub-paragraph (1) the CSO
seizes and retains a psychoactive substance, the CSO must—
(a) if the person from whom it was seized maintains that he
was lawfully in possession of it—
(i) tell the person where in quiries about its recovery
may be made, and
(ii) explain the effect of sections 49 to 51 and 53 of the
Psychoactive Substances Act 2016 (retention and
disposal of items), and
(b) comply with a constable’s instructions about what to do
with it.
